121: ਨਾਨਕ. ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ; ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੧੮॥੧੯॥
O Nanak, those imbued with the Name become discerning, and practise the Truth of truths. ॥8॥18॥19॥
Pure is the Word, and pure is the Bani.
Pure is the Light that pervades all.
ਨਿਰਮਲ ਬਾਣੀ. ਹਰਿ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ; ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ. ਮੈਲੁ ਗਵਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
Through the pure Bani I praise the Lord; chanting the Pure Lord, filth is washed away. ॥1॥
ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ; ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who enshrine the Giver of peace in their minds.
ਹਰਿ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ. ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਲਾਹੀ; ਸਬਦੋ ਸੁਣਿ. ਤਿਸਾ ਮਿਟਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Through the Guru's Word I praise the Pure Lord; hearing the Word, thirst is quenched. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
When the Pure Name comes to dwell in the mind,
ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ; ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਗਵਾਏ ॥
mind and body become pure, and attachment to Maya is gone.
ਨਿਰਮਲ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਨਿਤ. ਸਾਚੇ ਕੇ; ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨਾਦੁ ਵਜਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
One sings forever the pure praises of the True One, and the pure music of His praise resounds. ॥2॥
The pure nectar is obtained from the Guru.
ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਮੁਆ; ਤਿਥੈ. ਮੋਹੁ ਨ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
When self-conceit dies within, there is no attachment to Maya there.
ਨਿਰਮਲ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਅਤਿ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ; ਨਿਰਮਲ ਬਾਣੀ. ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
Pure is the wisdom, utterly pure the meditation, of one who enshrines the pure Bani in the mind. ॥3॥
ਜੋ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਸੇਵੇ; ਸੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
One who serves the Pure Lord becomes pure.
Through the Guru's Word he washes away the filth of ego.
ਨਿਰਮਲ ਵਾਜੈ. ਅਨਹਦ ਧੁਨਿ ਬਾਣੀ; ਦਰਿ ਸਚੈ. ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
The pure, unstruck melody of the Bani resounds within, and he is honoured at the True Door. ॥4॥
From the Pure One, all become pure.
Pure is the mind that is strung on the Lord's Word.
ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਗੇ ਬਡਭਾਗੀ; ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਨਾਮਿ ਸੁਹਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
Fortunate are those attached to the Pure Name; through the Name they are made pure and beautiful. ॥5॥
He alone is pure who is adorned with the Word.
His mind and body are enraptured by the Pure Name.
ਸਚਿ ਨਾਮਿ. ਮਲੁ ਕਦੇ. ਨ ਲਾਗੈ; ਮੁਖੁ ਊਜਲੁ ਸਚੁ ਕਰਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
Through the True Name filth never sticks to him; the True One makes his face radiant. ॥6॥
The mind is filthy through love of duality.
Filthy is the cooking square, and filthy the place.
ਮੈਲਾ ਖਾਇ. ਫਿਰਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਵਧਾਏ; ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮੈਲੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
Eating filth, the self-willed add to their filth, and through this filth they suffer pain. ॥7॥
The filthy and the pure all are under His command.
ਸੇ ਨਿਰਮਲ; ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਸਾਚੇ ਭਾਏ ॥
They alone are pure who are pleasing to the True Lord.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ. ਮੈਲੁ ਚੁਕਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੧੯॥੨੦॥
O Nanak, the Name dwells within the mind; the Guru-facing wash away their filth. ॥8॥19॥20॥
The Lord of the universe is radiant, and radiant are His swans (those who chant His Name).
My mind and speech become pure, and pure my desires.
ਮਨਿ ਊਜਲ ਸਦਾ ਮੁਖ ਸੋਹਹਿ; ਅਤਿ ਊਜਲ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
With radiant minds, their faces are ever beautiful; those who meditate on the Name are utterly radiant. ॥1॥
ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ; ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who sing the praises of the Lord of the universe.
ਗੋਬਿਦੁ ਗੋਬਿਦੁ ਕਹੈ ਦਿਨ ਰਾਤੀ; ਗੋਬਿਦ ਗੁਣ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਣਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
They chant "Gobind, Gobind" day and night, and through the Word they let others hear His praises. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Those who sing of the Lord of the universe with intuitive ease
ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭੈ ਊਜਲ; ਹਉਮੈ ਮਲੁ ਜਾਏ ॥
become radiant in the Guru's fear, and the filth of ego departs.
ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦਿ ਰਹਹਿ. ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ; ਸੁਣਿ ਗੋਬਿਦ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
They remain forever in bliss, worship day and night, and hear and sing the praises of the Lord of the universe. ॥2॥
The mind dances when devotion is implanted within.
ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ; ਮਨੈ ਮਨੁ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
Through the Guru's Word, the mind merges with the mind.
ਸਚਾ ਤਾਲੁ ਪੂਰੇ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਚੁਕਾਏ; ਸਬਦੇ ਨਿਰਤਿ ਕਰਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
Sharing out attachment to Maya is the true beat kept; through the Word one is made to dance. ॥3॥
One who shouts aloud and flings his body about,
entangled in Maya, is watched by the Messenger of Death.
122: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਇਸੁ ਮਨਹਿ ਨਚਾਏ; ਅੰਤਰਿ ਕਪਟੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
Attachment to Maya makes this mind dance; with deceit within, he suffers pain. ॥4॥
When the Lord Himself has one worship through the Guru,
body and mind are dyed with His love in intuitive ease.
ਬਾਣੀ ਵਜੈ. ਸਬਦਿ ਵਜਾਏ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਥਾਇ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
The Bani resounds, and one plays the Word; the devotion of the Guru-facing is accepted. ॥5॥
One may beat many rhythms and play musical instruments,
ਨਾ ਕੋ ਸੁਣੇ; ਨ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
but no one listens to the Name or enshrines it in the mind.
ਮਾਇਆ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਪਿੜ ਬੰਧਿ ਨਾਚੈ; ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
For the sake of Maya he marks out an arena and dances; in love of duality he suffers pain. ॥6॥
ਜਿਸੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਗੈ; ਸੋ ਮੁਕਤਾ ॥
One whose heart is filled with love for Him is liberated.
He controls his senses, and lives in the discipline of Truth.
ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਏ; ਏਹਾ ਭਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
Through the Guru's Word he meditates forever on the Lord; this devotion pleases the Lord. ॥7॥
Devotion through the Guru has prevailed through all four ages.
In no other way does anyone attain devotion.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਨਾਮੁ ਗੁਰ ਭਗਤੀ ਪਾਈਐ; ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੨੦॥੨੧॥
O Nanak, the Name is obtained through devotion to the Guru, by focusing the mind on the Guru's feet. ॥8॥20॥21॥
I serve the True One, and praise the True One.
ਸਚੈ ਨਾਇ; ਦੁਖੁ ਕਬ ਹੀ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
Through the True Name, pain never touches one.
ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਸੇਵਨਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਨਿ; ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
Those who serve the Giver of peace find peace; through the Guru's teaching they enshrine Him in the mind. ॥1॥
ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ; ਸੁਖ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਲਗਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who enter the trance of peace and poise.
ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਹਿ. ਸੇ ਸਦਾ ਸੋਹਹਿ; ਸੋਭਾ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸੁਹਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Those who serve the Lord are forever beautiful; their awareness is beautiful and honoured. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
but they alone are Your devotees who are pleasing to Your mind.
ਸਚੁ ਬਾਣੀ ਤੁਧੈ ਸਾਲਾਹਨਿ; ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
Through the true Bani they praise You; dyed in Your love, they worship You. ॥2॥
ਸਭੁ ਕੋ; ਸਚੇ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ. ਤੇਰਾ ॥
All are Yours, O dear True Lord.
Meeting the Guru, one's round of births ends.
ਜਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ. ਤਾ ਨਾਇ ਰਚਾਵਹਿ; ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਨਾਉ ਜਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
When it pleases You, You absorb us in the Name; You Yourself have us chant the Name. ॥3॥
Through the Guru's teaching, I have enshrined the Lord in my mind.
Pleasure and pain and all attachment are gone.
ਇਕਸੁ ਸਿਉ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ਸਦ ਹੀ; ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
I am forever attuned to the One, and have enshrined the Lord's Name in my mind. ॥4॥
ਭਗਤ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ; ਸਦਾ ਤੇਰੈ ਚਾਏ ॥
Your devotees are dyed in Your love, ever eager for You.
ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਨਾਮੁ; ਵਸਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਆਏ ॥
The Name, the nine treasures, has come to dwell in their minds.
ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਸਬਦੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
By perfect destiny one finds the True Guru, and through the Word is united in union. ॥5॥
You are merciful, forever the Giver of peace.
You Yourself unite us; through the Guru You are known.
ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਦੇਵਹਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਡਾਈ; ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
You Yourself bless us with the glory of the Name; imbued with the Name, we find peace. ॥6॥
Forever and ever, O True Lord, I praise You.
Through the Guru You are known; there is no other.
ਏਕਸੁ ਸਿਉ ਮਨੁ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਏ; ਮਨਿ ਮੰਨਿਐ ਮਨਹਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
The mind remains absorbed in the One; when the mind is won over, it merges into the mind. ॥7॥
ਨਾਨਕ. ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ; ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੨੧॥੨੨॥
O Nanak, the Name dwells within the mind; through the Guru's Word one is united with the Lord. ॥8॥21॥22॥
Your devotees look beautiful in the True Court.
Through the Guru's Word they are adorned with the Name.
ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦਿ ਰਹਹਿ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ; ਗੁਣ ਕਹਿ ਗੁਣੀ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
Day and night they remain forever in bliss; chanting His virtues, they merge in the Virtuous One. ॥1॥
123: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ; ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਣਿ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who hear the Name and enshrine it in their minds.
ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਸਚਾ. ਊਚੋ ਊਚਾ; ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ. ਮਿਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
The dear Lord is true, the highest of the high; killing ego, one is united with Him. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
The dear Lord is true, and true is His glory.
By the Guru's grace He unites a rare one with Himself.
ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਹਿ. ਸੇ ਵਿਛੁੜਹਿ ਨਾਹੀ; ਸਹਜੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
Those united through the Guru's Word are never separated; they merge intuitively in the True One. ॥2॥
ਤੁਝ ਤੇ ਬਾਹਰਿ; ਕਛੂ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
ਤੂੰ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖਹਿ; ਜਾਣਹਿ ਸੋਇ ॥
You create and watch over it, and You know all.
ਆਪੇ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਏ ਕਰਤਾ; ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
The Creator Himself acts and causes all to act; through the Guru's teaching He Himself unites. ॥3॥
The virtuous soul-bride finds the Lord;
she makes fear and love of Him her adornment.
ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੋਹਾਗਣਿ; ਸਚ ਉਪਦੇਸਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
Serving the True Guru she is forever a happy bride, absorbed in the true teaching. ॥4॥
ਸਬਦੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਨਿ; ਤਿਨਾ. ਠਉਰੁ ਨ ਠਾਉ ॥
Those who forget the Word find no place of rest.
ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਭੂਲੇ; ਜਿਉ ਸੁੰਞੈ ਘਰਿ ਕਾਉ ॥
Lost in doubt, they are like a crow in a deserted house.
ਹਲਤੁ ਪਲਤੁ ਤਿਨੀ ਦੋਵੈ ਗਵਾਏ; ਦੁਖੇ ਦੁਖਿ ਵਿਹਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
They lose both this world and the next, and pass their lives in pain upon pain. ॥5॥
Writing and writing (accounts of Maya), they use up paper and ink,
ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ; ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
yet in love of duality no one has ever found peace.
ਕੂੜੁ ਲਿਖਹਿ ਤੈ ਕੂੜੁ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ; ਜਲਿ ਜਾਵਹਿ. ਕੂੜਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
They write falsehood and practise falsehood; with their consciousness fixed on falsehood, they burn. ॥6॥
The Guru-facing write the Truth of truths, and reflect on Him.
ਸੇ ਜਨ ਸਚੇ; ਪਾਵਹਿ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰੁ ॥
Those humble beings are true; they find the door of liberation.
ਸਚੁ ਕਾਗਦੁ ਕਲਮ ਮਸਵਾਣੀ; ਸਚੁ ਲਿਖਿ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
True is their paper, pen and inkwell; writing Truth, they merge in the True One. ॥7॥
My God sits within, watching over all.
ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਮਿਲੈ; ਸੋਈ ਜਨੁ ਲੇਖੈ ॥
One who meets Him by the Guru's grace is accepted.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ; ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੨੨॥੨੩॥
O Nanak, through the Name glory is obtained; it is received from the perfect Guru. ॥8॥22॥23॥
ਆਤਮ ਰਾਮ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ; ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
The light of the all-pervading Lord dawns through the Guru.
The filth of ego that clings is washed away through the Guru's Word.
ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਭਗਤੀ ਰਾਤਾ; ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
The mind becomes pure, dyed in devotion night and day; worshipping Him, one finds the Lord. ॥1॥
ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ; ਆਪਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਨਿ. ਅਵਰਾ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who worship Him themselves and inspire others to worship.
ਤਿਨਾ ਭਗਤ ਜਨਾ ਕਉ. ਸਦ ਨਮਸਕਾਰੁ ਕੀਜੈ; ਜੋ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Bow forever to those devotees who sing the Lord's praises night and day. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
The Creator Himself brings about the cause,
and puts each to the task that pleases Him.
ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ. ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਹੋਵੈ; ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
By perfect destiny one serves the Guru, and through service to the Guru finds peace. ॥2॥
ਮਰਿ ਮਰਿ ਜੀਵੈ; ਤਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
When one dies (to self) and lives again, one obtains something.
By the Guru's grace one enshrines the Lord in the mind.
ਸਦਾ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ; ਸਹਜੇ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
Enshrining the Lord in the mind, one is liberated forever, and merges in poise upon poise. ॥3॥
ਬਹੁ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵੈ; ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਪਾਏ ॥
One may perform many rituals, but does not attain liberation.
One may wander through foreign lands, but is ruined by love of duality.
ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਕਪਟੀ; ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ. ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
The deceitful waste their lives in vain; without the Word they suffer pain. ॥4॥
One who restrains the wandering mind and holds it in check
by the Guru's grace attains the supreme state.
ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ; ਮਿਲਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
The True Guru Himself unites him in union; meeting the Beloved, he finds peace. ॥5॥
124: ਇਕਿ ਕੂੜਿ ਲਾਗੇ; ਕੂੜੇ ਫਲ ਪਾਏ ॥
Some are attached to falsehood, and receive false fruits.
In love of duality they waste their lives in vain.
ਆਪਿ ਡੁਬੇ ਸਗਲੇ ਕੁਲ ਡੋਬੇ; ਕੂੜੁ ਬੋਲਿ ਬਿਖੁ ਖਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
They drown themselves and drown all their families; speaking falsehood, they eat poison. ॥6॥
ਇਸੁ ਤਨ ਮਹਿ ਮਨੁ; ਕੋ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਦੇਖੈ ॥
Rare is the Guru-facing one who sees the mind within this body,
when through loving devotion he dries up ego.
ਸਿਧ ਸਾਧਿਕ ਮੋਨਿਧਾਰੀ. ਰਹੇ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ; ਤਿਨ ਭੀ ਤਨ ਮਹਿ. ਮਨੁ ਨ ਦਿਖਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
Adepts, seekers and silent sages strive to concentrate, yet even they have not seen the mind within the body. ॥7॥
The Creator Himself causes all to act.
ਹੋਰੁ ਕਿ ਕਰੇ; ਕੀਤੈ ਕਿਆ ਹੋਈ ॥
What can anyone else do? What can be done by what He has made?
ਨਾਨਕ. ਜਿਸੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਵੈ. ਸੋ ਲੇਵੈ; ਨਾਮੋ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੨੩॥੨੪॥
O Nanak, one to whom He gives the Name receives it, and enshrines the Name in the mind. ॥8॥23॥24॥
Within this cave (the body) is an inexhaustible treasure.
ਤਿਸੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਵਸੈ; ਹਰਿ ਅਲਖ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
Within it dwells the unseen, infinite Lord.
ਆਪੇ; ਗੁਪਤੁ. ਪਰਗਟੁ ਹੈ ਆਪੇ; ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ. ਆਪੁ ਵੰਞਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
He Himself is hidden and He Himself manifest; through the Guru's Word self-conceit is shed. ॥1॥
ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ; ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who enshrine the life-giving Name in their minds.
ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਹਾ ਰਸੁ ਮੀਠਾ; ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਆਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
The life-giving Name is supremely sweet; through the Guru's teaching one drinks this nectar. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Killing ego, the heavy, hard doors are opened,
and the priceless Name is obtained by the Guru's grace.
ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ. ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਪਾਏ ਕੋਈ; ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
Without the Word no one obtains the Name; by the Guru's grace it is enshrined in the mind. ॥2॥
ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨ ਅੰਜਨੁ ਸਚੁ; ਨੇਤ੍ਰੀ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
One who has applied the true ointment of the Guru's wisdom to his eyes
has light within, and the darkness of ignorance is dispelled.
ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲੀ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ; ਹਰਿ ਦਰਿ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
His light merges into the Light, his mind is won over, and he is honoured at the Lord's door. ॥3॥
If someone goes outside the body to search,
ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਲਹੈ; ਬਹੁਤੁ ਵੇਗਾਰਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
he does not find the Name, and suffers great pain like a forced labourer.
ਮਨਮੁਖ ਅੰਧੇ. ਸੂਝੈ ਨਾਹੀ; ਫਿਰਿ ਘਿਰਿ ਆਇ, ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਥੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
The blind self-willed do not understand; after wandering they come back, and through the Guru find the treasure. ॥4॥
By the Guru's grace one finds the True Lord,
ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਵੇਖੈ; ਹਉਮੈ ਮੈਲੁ ਜਾਏ ॥
sees Him in mind and body, and the filth of ego departs.
ਬੈਸਿ ਸੁਥਾਨਿ. ਸਦ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ; ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
Sitting in that blessed place (the heart), one sings the Lord's praises forever, and merges in the True Word. ॥5॥
One who closes the nine doors and restrains the wandering mind
comes to dwell in his own home, through the tenth gate.
ਓਥੈ ਅਨਹਦ ਸਬਦ. ਵਜਹਿ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ; ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਣਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
There the unstruck melody of the Word resounds day and night; through the Guru's teaching one hears the Word. ॥6॥
Without the Word there is darkness within.
ਨ ਵਸਤੁ ਲਹੈ; ਨ ਚੂਕੈ ਫੇਰਾ ॥
One does not find the treasure, and the round of births does not end.
ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਹਥਿ ਕੁੰਜੀ. ਹੋਰਤੁ ਦਰੁ ਖੁਲੈ ਨਾਹੀ; ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰੈ. ਭਾਗਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
The key is in the True Guru's hands; the door opens in no other way; by perfect destiny one meets the Guru. ॥7॥
You are hidden and manifest in all places.
Meeting the Guru, by His grace, this understanding is obtained.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹਿ ਸਦਾ ਤੂੰ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੨੪॥੨੫॥
O Nanak, praise the Name forever; the Guru-facing enshrine it in the mind. ॥8॥24॥25॥
Through the Guru one meets the Lord; He Himself unites.
ਕਾਲੁ ਨ ਜੋਹੈ; ਦੁਖੁ ਨ ਸੰਤਾਪੇ ॥
Death does not touch him, nor does pain afflict him.
ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਬੰਧਨ ਸਭ ਤੋੜੈ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਹਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
Killing ego, he breaks all his bonds; through the Guru's Word he is made beautiful. ॥1॥
ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ; ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸੁਹਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those made beautiful by the Lord's Name.
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗਾਵੈ. ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਚੈ; ਹਰਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
The Guru-facing one sings, the Guru-facing one dances, and focuses his consciousness on the Lord. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
125: The Guru-facing one lives and dies (to self), and is approved.
His life does not waste away, for he recognises the Word.
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਰੈ ਨ, ਕਾਲੁ ਨ ਖਾਏ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
The Guru-facing does not die (spiritually), nor does Death devour him; the Guru-facing merges in the True One. ॥2॥
The Guru-facing is honoured at the Lord's door.
The Guru-facing sheds self-conceit from within.
ਆਪਿ ਤਰੈ ਕੁਲ ਸਗਲੇ ਤਾਰੇ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ. ਜਨਮੁ ਸਵਾਰਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
He is saved himself and saves all his family; the Guru-facing makes his life beautiful. ॥3॥
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ; ਦੁਖੁ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਲਗੈ ਸਰੀਰਿ ॥
Pain never afflicts the body of the Guru-facing.
For the Guru-facing, the pain of ego ends.
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ. ਫਿਰਿ ਮੈਲੁ, ਨ ਲਾਗੈ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
The mind of the Guru-facing is pure, and filth does not stick to it again; the Guru-facing merge in poise. ॥4॥
The Guru-facing obtain the glory of the Name.
The Guru-facing sing His praises and are honoured.
ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦਿ ਰਹੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਕਰਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
Day and night they remain forever in bliss; the Guru-facing practise the Word. ॥5॥
The Guru-facing are imbued with the Word night and day.
The Guru-facing are known throughout the four ages.
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ, ਸਦਾ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ; ਸਬਦੇ. ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
The Guru-facing sing His praises and are forever pure; through the Word they worship Him. ॥6॥
Without the Guru there is pitch darkness.
Seized by the Messenger of Death, people cry out.
ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਰੋਗੀ ਬਿਸਟਾ ਕੇ ਕੀੜੇ; ਬਿਸਟਾ ਮਹਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
Night and day they are diseased, like worms in filth, suffering in filth. ॥7॥
The Guru-facing know that He Himself acts and causes all to act.
In the hearts of the Guru-facing He Himself comes to dwell.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਨਾਮਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ; ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੨੫॥੨੬॥
O Nanak, through the Name glory is obtained; it is received from the perfect Guru. ॥8॥25॥26॥
The one Light is the light in all bodies.
The perfect True Guru reveals it through the Word.
ਆਪੇ. ਫਰਕੁ ਕੀਤੋਨੁ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ; ਆਪੇ ਬਣਤ ਬਣਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
He Himself has made the differences among hearts; He Himself has fashioned the form of all. ॥1॥
ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ; ਹਰਿ ਸਚੇ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who sing the praises of the True Lord.
ਬਾਝੁ ਗੁਰੂ. ਕੋ, ਸਹਜੁ ਨ ਪਾਏ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Without the Guru no one attains poise; the Guru-facing merge in poise. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਸੋਹਹਿ; ਆਪੇ ਜਗੁ ਮੋਹਹਿ ॥
You Yourself are beautiful, and You Yourself entice the world.
You Yourself, by Your glance of grace, string the world together.
ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਦੇਵਹਿ ਕਰਤੇ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਦੇਖਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
You Yourself give pain and pleasure, O Creator; to the Guru-facing You reveal Yourself, O Lord. ॥2॥
The Creator Himself acts and causes all to act.
He Himself enshrines the Guru's Word in the mind.
ਸਬਦੇ ਉਪਜੈ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਣੀ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਖਿ ਸੁਣਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
Through the Word the life-giving Bani wells up; the Guru-facing speak it and let others hear. ॥3॥
He Himself is the Creator, and He Himself the Enjoyer.
He breaks the bonds, and is Himself forever free.
ਸਦਾ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਆਪੇ ਹੈ ਸਚਾ; ਆਪੇ. ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
The True One is Himself forever free; the Unseen One Himself makes Himself seen. ॥4॥
He Himself is Maya, and He Himself its shadow (its spell).
He Himself created attachment and the whole world.
ਆਪੇ ਗੁਣਦਾਤਾ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ; ਆਪੇ ਆਖਿ ਸੁਣਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
He Himself, the Giver of virtue, sings His praises, and Himself speaks them for others to hear. ॥5॥
He Himself acts, and He Himself causes others to act.
ਤੁਝ ਤੇ ਬਾਹਰਿ. ਕਛੂ ਨ ਹੋਵੈ; ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਕਾਰੈ ਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
Nothing happens without You; You Yourself put all to their tasks. ॥6॥
He Himself kills, and He Himself gives life.
He Himself unites, and joins in union.
ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ. ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
Through service lasting peace is found; the Guru-facing merge in poise. ॥7॥
126: He Himself is the highest of the high.
ਜਿਸੁ ਆਪਿ ਵਿਖਾਲੇ; ਸੁ ਵੇਖੈ ਕੋਈ ॥
Rare is the one who sees, to whom He Himself reveals Himself.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸੈ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ; ਆਪੇ ਵੇਖਿ ਵਿਖਾਲਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੨੬॥੨੭॥
O Nanak, the Name dwells within the heart; He Himself sees and reveals. ॥8॥26॥27॥
ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ; ਸਭ ਥਾਈ ॥
My God is pervading all places.
ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ; ਘਰ ਹੀ ਮਹਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
By the Guru's grace I have found Him within my own home (heart).
ਸਦਾ ਸਰੇਵੀ ਇਕ ਮਨਿ ਧਿਆਈ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
I serve Him forever and meditate on Him single-mindedly; the Guru-facing merge in the True One. ॥1॥
ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ; ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who enshrine the Life of the world in their minds.
ਹਰਿ ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਦਾਤਾ; ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
The Lord, Life of the world, is the fearless Giver; through the Guru's teaching one merges in poise. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Within the home (heart) is He who supports the earth and the underworlds.
ਘਰ ਹੀ ਮਹਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ; ਸਦਾ ਹੈ ਬਾਲਾ ॥
Within the home is the Beloved, ever young.
ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦਿ ਰਹੈ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ; ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
One who meditates on the Giver of peace remains forever in bliss; through the Guru's teaching he merges in poise. ॥2॥
Within the body there is ego and possessiveness;
the round of birth and death does not end.
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ. ਸੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰੇ; ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ਧਿਆਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
One who becomes Guru-facing subdues his ego, and meditates on the Truest of the true. ॥3॥
ਕਾਇਆ ਅੰਦਰਿ; ਪਾਪੁ ਪੁੰਨੁ ਦੁਇ ਭਾਈ ॥
Within the body are two brothers, sin and virtue.
Together they have produced the world.
ਦੋਵੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਜਾਇ. ਇਕਤੁ ਘਰਿ ਆਵੈ; ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
Killing both, one comes to the one home; through the Guru's teaching one merges in poise. ॥4॥
ਘਰ ਹੀ ਮਾਹਿ; ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਅਨੇਰਾ ॥
Within the home itself is the darkness of love of duality.
Light dawns when one sheds ego and possessiveness.
ਪਰਗਟੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਹੈ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ; ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
The Word, the Giver of peace, becomes manifest, and one meditates on the Name night and day. ॥5॥
The Light that spread out the whole creation becomes manifest within.
Through the Guru's teaching darkness is dispelled.
ਕਮਲੁ ਬਿਗਾਸਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
The heart-lotus blossoms, lasting peace is found, and the light merges into the Light. ॥6॥
Within the mansion (the body) are storehouses overflowing with jewels.
The Guru-facing obtain the infinite Name.
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਣਜੇ ਸਦਾ ਵਾਪਾਰੀ; ਲਾਹਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
The Guru-facing trader trades forever, and always earns the profit of the Name. ॥7॥
He Himself keeps the treasure, and He Himself gives it.
Rare, very rare are those who trade in it through the Guru.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਜਿਸੁ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਸੋ ਪਾਏ; ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੨੭॥੨੮॥
O Nanak, one on whom He casts His glance obtains it; in His mercy He enshrines it in the mind. ॥8॥27॥28॥
The Lord Himself unites, and has His service done.
ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ; ਭਾਉ ਦੂਜਾ ਜਾਏ ॥
Through the Guru's Word love of duality departs.
ਹਰਿ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਸਦਾ ਗੁਣਦਾਤਾ; ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਮਹਿ ਆਪਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
The Lord is pure, forever the Giver of virtue; the Lord Himself absorbs one in His virtues. ॥1॥
ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ; ਸਚੁ ਸਚਾ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਵਸਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who enshrine the Truest of the true in their hearts.
ਸਚਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦਾ ਹੈ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ; ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
The True Name is forever pure; through the Guru's Word it is enshrined in the mind. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
He Himself is the Guru and the Giver; He is the Architect of destiny by deeds.
His servants serve Him; through the Guru they know the Lord.
ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਦਾ ਜਨ ਸੋਹਹਿ; ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
His humble servants are forever beautiful in the life-giving Name; through the Guru's teaching they obtain the Lord's essence. ॥2॥
ਇਸੁ ਗੁਫਾ ਮਹਿ; ਇਕੁ ਥਾਨੁ ਸੁਹਾਇਆ ॥
Within this cave (the body) one place is made beautiful,
when the perfect Guru dispels ego and doubt.
ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹਨਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ; ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
Night and day they praise the Name, dyed in His love; by the Guru's grace they find Him. ॥3॥
127: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ; ਇਹੁ ਗੁਫਾ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
Through the Guru's Word one reflects within this cave,
and the Pure Name of the Lord dwells within.
ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ. ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਹਾਏ; ਮਿਲਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
Singing the Lord's praises, one is adorned by the Word; meeting the Beloved, one finds peace. ॥4॥
ਜਮੁ ਜਾਗਾਤੀ; ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ. ਕਰੁ ਲਾਏ ॥
Death, the tax collector, levies his tax on those in love of duality.
He punishes those who have forgotten the Name.
ਘੜੀ ਮੁਹਤ ਕਾ ਲੇਖਾ ਲੇਵੈ; ਰਤੀਅਹੁ ਮਾਸਾ ਤੋਲ ਕਢਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
He takes account of every moment and instant, weighing every grain and every gram. ॥5॥
The bride who does not remember her Husband in her parents' home (this world),
ਖਰੀ ਕੁਆਲਿਓ ਕੁਰੂਪਿ ਕੁਲਖਣੀ; ਸੁਪਨੈ. ਪਿਰੁ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
She is called low-born, ugly and ill-mannered; even in dreams she does not meet her Husband. ॥6॥
She who enshrined her Husband in her mind in her parents' home,
to whom the perfect Guru has shown Him ever present —
ਕਾਮਣਿ. ਪਿਰੁ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਕੰਠਿ ਲਾਇ; ਸਬਦੇ. ਪਿਰੁ ਰਾਵੈ ਸੇਜ ਸੁਹਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
that bride keeps her Husband clasped to her heart; through the Word she enjoys her Husband on her beautiful bed. ॥7॥
He Himself calls and gives the gift.
He enshrines His own Name in the mind.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ; ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸਦਾ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੨੮॥੨੯॥
O Nanak, one who obtains the Name obtains glory, and sings His praises forever, night and day. ॥8॥28॥29॥
Sublime is the birth of those who dwell in the blessed place (the true congregation).
They serve the True Guru, and remain detached within their own homes.
ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਹਹਿ ਸਦਾ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ; ਹਰਿ ਰਸਿ ਮਨੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
They remain in the Lord's love, forever dyed in it; their minds are satisfied with the Lord's essence. ॥1॥
ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ; ਪੜਿ ਬੁਝਿ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who read, understand and enshrine Him in their minds.
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪੜਹਿ. ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹਹਿ; ਦਰਿ ਸਚੈ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
The Guru-facing read and praise the Lord's Name, and are honoured at the True Door. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
The unseen, inscrutable Lord pervades all.
He cannot be found by any other means.
ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਤਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟੈ; ਨਦਰੀ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
When He shows mercy, one meets the True Guru; by His glance of grace He unites in union. ॥2॥
One who reads in love of duality does not understand.
He struggles for the sake of three-qualitied Maya.
ਤ੍ਰਿਬਿਧਿ ਬੰਧਨ ਤੂਟਹਿ. ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ; ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ. ਮੁਕਤਿ ਕਰਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
The bonds of the three qualities are broken through the Guru's Word; through the Guru's Word liberation comes. ॥3॥
ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਚੰਚਲੁ; ਵਸਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
This fickle mind cannot be controlled.
Attached to duality, it runs in all ten directions.
ਬਿਖੁ ਕਾ ਕੀੜਾ. ਬਿਖੁ ਮਹਿ ਰਾਤਾ; ਬਿਖੁ ਹੀ ਮਾਹਿ ਪਚਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
A worm of poison, absorbed in poison, it rots in poison. ॥4॥
ਹਉ ਹਉ ਕਰੇ; ਤੈ ਆਪੁ ਜਣਾਏ ॥
He acts in ego and shows himself off.
ਬਹੁ ਕਰਮ ਕਰੈ; ਕਿਛੁ ਥਾਇ. ਨ ਪਾਏ ॥
He performs many rituals, but none are accepted.
ਤੁਝ ਤੇ ਬਾਹਰਿ. ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਹੋਵੈ; ਬਖਸੇ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਹਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
Nothing happens without You; those You forgive are adorned with the Word. ॥5॥
One who does not understand the Lord is born and wastes away.
Night and day such people wander in love of duality.
ਮਨਮੁਖ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਇਆ ਹੈ ਬਿਰਥਾ; ਅੰਤਿ ਗਇਆ ਪਛੁਤਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
The self-willed waste their lives in vain, and depart regretting in the end. ॥6॥
Her husband is abroad, yet she adorns herself;
such are the deeds the blind self-willed do.
ਹਲਤਿ ਨ ਸੋਭਾ. ਪਲਤਿ ਨ ਢੋਈ; ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
They have no honour in this world and no shelter in the next; they waste their lives in vain. ॥7॥
ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ; ਕਿਨੈ ਵਿਰਲੈ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
Rare is the one who knows the Lord's Name.
Through the perfect Guru's Word one recognises Him.
ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ; ਸਹਜੇ ਹੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥
Night and day he worships, day and night, and finds peace with intuitive ease. ॥8॥
Rare is the Guru-facing one who understands this.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਜਨ ਸੋਹਹਿ; ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੯॥੨੯॥੩੦॥
O Nanak, those imbued with the Name are beautiful; in His mercy He unites them with Himself. ॥9॥29॥30॥
128: The self-willed read, and call themselves pandits.
In love of duality they suffer terrible pain.
ਬਿਖਿਆ ਮਾਤੇ. ਕਿਛੁ ਸੂਝੈ ਨਾਹੀ; ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਜੂਨੀ ਆਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
Intoxicated with Maya they understand nothing, and enter wombs again and again. ॥1॥
ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ; ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who subdue ego and unite with Him.
ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ. ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ; ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਸਹਜਿ ਪੀਆਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Through service to the Guru the Lord dwells in their minds, and they drink the Lord's essence with intuitive ease. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਵੇਦੁ ਪੜਹਿ; ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ. ਨਹੀ ਆਇਆ ॥
They read the Vedas but do not get the taste of the Lord's essence.
They expound arguments, enticed by Maya.
ਅਗਿਆਨਮਤੀ ਸਦਾ ਅੰਧਿਆਰਾ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝਿ ਹਰਿ ਗਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
Their ignorant intellect is forever in darkness; the Guru-facing understand and sing of the Lord. ॥2॥
The Indescribable is described, and through the Word He looks beautiful.
Through the Guru's teaching the True One is pleasing to the mind.
ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ਰਵਹਿ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ; ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਸਚਿ ਰੰਗਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
They dwell on the Truest of the true day and night, and this mind is dyed in the True One. ॥3॥
ਜੋ ਸਚਿ ਰਤੇ; ਤਿਨ ਸਚੋ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
Those imbued with the True One find the True One pleasing.
He Himself gives, and does not regret it.
ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਦਾ ਸਚੁ ਜਾਤਾ; ਮਿਲਿ ਸਚੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
Through the Guru's Word they know the True One forever, and meeting the True One they find peace. ॥4॥
ਕੂੜੁ ਕੁਸਤੁ; ਤਿਨਾ. ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
Falsehood and deceit do not stain them with filth.
By the Guru's grace they remain awake night and day.
ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸੈ ਘਟ ਭੀਤਰਿ; ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
The Pure Name dwells within the heart, and the light merges into the Light. ॥5॥
ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਪੜਹਿ; ਹਰਿ ਤਤੁ. ਨ ਜਾਣਹਿ ॥
They read of the three qualities, but do not know the essence of the Lord.
They have forgotten the Primal Source and do not recognise the Guru's Word.
ਮੋਹ ਬਿਆਪੇ. ਕਿਛੁ ਸੂਝੈ ਨਾਹੀ; ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
Engrossed in attachment they understand nothing; through the Guru's Word the Lord is found. ॥6॥
The Vedas proclaim the three-qualitied Maya.
The self-willed, in love of duality, do not understand.
ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਪੜਹਿ. ਹਰਿ ਏਕੁ, ਨ ਜਾਣਹਿ; ਬਿਨੁ ਬੂਝੇ. ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
They read of the three qualities but do not know the One Lord; without understanding, they suffer pain. ॥7॥
ਜਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ; ਤਾ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
When it pleases Him, He Himself unites us with Himself,
and through the Guru's Word dispels anxiety and pain.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਨਾਵੈ ਕੀ ਸਚੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ; ਨਾਮੋ ਮੰਨਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੩੦॥੩੧॥
O Nanak, true is the glory of the Name; believing in the Name, one finds peace. ॥8॥30॥31॥
He Himself is without qualities and with qualities.
One who recognises this essence is a true pandit.
ਆਪਿ ਤਰੈ ਸਗਲੇ ਕੁਲ ਤਾਰੈ; ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
He is saved himself and saves all his family, enshrining the Lord's Name in his mind. ॥1॥
ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ; ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਚਖਿ. ਸਾਦੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who taste the Lord's essence and enjoy its flavour.
ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖਹਿ. ਸੇ ਜਨ ਨਿਰਮਲ; ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Those who taste the Lord's essence are pure; they meditate on the Pure Name. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
He is free of desire-bound action who reflects on the Word.
Within, through spiritual wisdom, the essence is revealed, and he subdues his ego.
ਨਾਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਏ; ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਮੇਟਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
He obtains the treasure of the Name, the nine treasures, and erasing the three qualities, merges in the Lord. ॥2॥
One who acts in ego is not free of desire-bound action.
By the Guru's grace one sheds ego.
ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਿਬੇਕੁ ਸਦਾ ਆਪੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ; ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
With discernment within, he reflects forever on his own self, and through the Guru's Word sings His praises. ॥3॥
The Lord is the pool and the ocean; He alone is pure.
The saints, through the Guru, peck (the pearls of the Name) there every day.
ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ਕਰਹਿ ਸਦਾ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ; ਹਉਮੈ ਮੈਲੁ ਚੁਕਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
They bathe there day and night forever, and wash away the filth of ego. ॥4॥
The pure swans abide in loving devotion.
Killing ego, they dwell in the Lord's pool.
129: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ. ਸਬਦਿ ਸਾਚੈ; ਹਰਿ ਸਰਿ ਵਾਸਾ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
Day and night they love the True Word, and dwell in the Lord's pool. ॥5॥
ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਸਦਾ ਬਗੁ ਮੈਲਾ; ਹਉਮੈ ਮਲੁ ਲਾਈ ॥
The self-willed is forever a filthy heron, smeared with the filth of ego.
ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ਕਰੈ; ਪਰੁ ਮੈਲੁ. ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
He bathes, but his filth does not go.
ਜੀਵਤੁ ਮਰੈ. ਗੁਰਸਬਦੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੈ; ਹਉਮੈ ਮੈਲੁ ਚੁਕਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
One who dies while alive and reflects on the Guru's Word washes away the filth of ego. ॥6॥
He found the priceless jewel within his own home (heart),
when the perfect True Guru had him hear the Word.
ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ. ਮਿਟਿਆ ਅੰਧਿਆਰਾ; ਘਟਿ ਚਾਨਣੁ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਨਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
By the Guru's grace the darkness was dispelled; light dawned within, and he recognised his own self. ॥7॥
He Himself creates, and He Himself watches over all.
One who serves the True Guru is accepted.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸੈ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ; ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ. ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੩੧॥੩੨॥
O Nanak, the Name dwells within the heart; by the Guru's grace it is obtained. ॥8॥31॥32॥
The whole world is engrossed in attachment to Maya.
All are seen under the three qualities, enticed by Maya.
ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਕੋ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਬੂਝੈ; ਚਉਥੈ ਪਦਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
By the Guru's grace, rare is the one who understands; he is attuned to the fourth state. ॥1॥
ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ; ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ. ਸਬਦਿ ਜਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who burn away attachment to Maya through the Word.
ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਜਲਾਏ. ਸੋ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਏ; ਹਰਿ ਦਰਿ ਮਹਲੀ. ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
One who burns away attachment to Maya focuses his consciousness on the Lord, and is honoured at the Lord's door and in His mansion. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
The root of gods and goddesses is Maya (desire for comfort and fear of pain).
It is Maya that produced the Simritees and Shastras.
ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਪਸਰਿਆ ਸੰਸਾਰੇ; ਆਇ ਜਾਇ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
Lust and anger are spread throughout the world; coming and going, people suffer pain. ॥2॥
ਤਿਸੁ ਵਿਚਿ; ਗਿਆਨ ਰਤਨੁ ਇਕੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Within this world, one jewel of spiritual wisdom is found.
By the Guru's grace it is enshrined in the mind.
ਜਤੁ ਸਤੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ; ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
Such a one practises celibacy, truth, self-discipline and Truth, and through the perfect Guru meditates on the Name. ॥3॥
In her parents' home (this world) the bride wanders, deluded by doubt.
Attached to duality, she regrets it afterwards.
ਹਲਤੁ ਪਲਤੁ ਦੋਵੈ ਗਵਾਏ ਸੁਪਨੈ; ਸੁਖੁ. .ਨ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
She loses both this world and the next, and does not find peace even in dreams. ॥4॥
The bride who remembers her Husband in her parents' home
sees Him close at hand, by the Guru's grace.
ਪਿਰ ਕੈ ਸਹਜਿ, ਰਹੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੀ; ਸਬਦਿ ਸਿੰਗਾਰੁ ਬਣਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
Steady in her Husband's poise, she remains dyed in His love, and makes the Word her adornment. ॥5॥
Fruitful is the life of those who have found the True Guru.
Through the Guru's Word they have burnt away love of duality.
ਏਕੋ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ; ਮਿਲਿ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
The One pervades their hearts; joining the true congregation, they sing the Lord's praises. ॥6॥
ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਨ ਸੇਵੇ; ਸੋ ਕਾਹੇ ਆਇਆ ॥
One who does not serve the True Guru — why did he even come into the world?
Cursed is his life; he has wasted it in vain.
ਮਨਮੁਖਿ. ਨਾਮੁ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ; ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ. ਬਹੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
The Name does not come into the mind of the self-willed; without the Name he suffers terrible pain. ॥7॥
He who created the world alone knows it.
He Himself unites, and through the Word, recognises.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਜਨ ਕਉ; ਜਿਨ ਧੁਰਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲੇਖੁ ਲਿਖਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੧॥੩੨॥੩੩॥
O Nanak, they alone obtain the Name on whose foreheads such destiny was written from the start. ॥8॥1॥32॥33॥
The Primal Being is infinite, He Himself.
He Himself establishes, and having established, disestablishes.
ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਵਰਤੈ ਏਕੋ ਸੋਈ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
The One alone pervades all; the Guru-facing are honoured. ॥1॥
ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ; ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਣਿਆ ॥
I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who meditate on the Name of the Formless Lord.
130: ਤਿਸੁ ਰੂਪੁ ਨ ਰੇਖਿਆ. ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਦੇਖਿਆ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ. ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
He has no form or feature, yet He is seen in each and every heart; through the Guru the Unseen is seen. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
You are merciful and compassionate, the Lord of all.
ਤੁਧੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੂਜਾ; ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
Without You there is no other at all.
ਗੁਰੁ ਪਰਸਾਦੁ ਕਰੇ. ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਵੈ; ਨਾਮੇ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
When the Guru grants his grace, he gives the Name; through the Name one merges in the Name. ॥2॥
You Yourself are the True Creator.
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਮਨੁ ਭੀਜੈ; ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਲਗਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
Through the Guru one receives the Name, the mind is drenched, and one enters the trance of poise. ॥3॥
Night and day may I sing Your praises, O God.
May I praise You, O my Beloved.
ਤੁਧੁ ਬਿਨੁ. ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਜਾਚਾ; ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਤੂੰ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
Without You I beg from no other; by the Guru's grace You are found. ॥4॥
You are inaccessible and imperceptible; Your extent cannot be found.
ਅਪਣੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਹਿ; ਤੂੰ ਲੈਹਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ॥
When You show mercy, You unite us with Yourself.
ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਧਿਆਈਐ; ਸਬਦੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
Meditate on Him through the perfect Guru's Word; serving the Word, peace is found. ॥5॥
Virtuous is the tongue that sings His praises.
One who praises the Name is pleasing to the True One.
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਦਾ ਰਹੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੀ; ਮਿਲਿ ਸਚੇ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
The Guru-facing remain forever dyed in His love; meeting the True One, they are honoured. ॥6॥
The self-willed perform rituals in ego,
and lose their whole life in the gamble.
ਅੰਤਰਿ ਲੋਭੁ ਮਹਾ ਗੁਬਾਰਾ; ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
Within is greed and pitch darkness; again and again they come and go. ॥7॥
ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਆਪਿ; ਲਿਖਤੁ ਧੁਰਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
on those whose destiny He Himself wrote from the start.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਭਉ ਭੰਜਨੁ; ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੧॥੩੪॥
O Nanak, they obtain the Name, the Destroyer of fear; through the Guru's Word they find peace. ॥8॥1॥34॥
The Unseen One is within, but cannot be seen.
He has taken the jewel of the Name and hidden it within.
ਅਗਮੁ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ. ਸਭ ਤੇ ਊਚਾ; ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਲਖਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
The inaccessible, imperceptible, highest of all, is seen through the Guru's Word. ॥1॥
ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ; ਕਲਿ ਮਹਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਣਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who in this Dark Age let others hear the Name.
ਸੰਤ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਸਚੈ ਧਾਰੇ; ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
The beloved saints are upheld by the True One; by great good fortune they obtain His sight. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
He for whom the seekers and adepts wander,
on whom Brahma and Indra meditate in their hearts,
ਕੋਟਿ ਤੇਤੀਸਾ ਖੋਜਹਿ ਤਾ ਕਉ; ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ. ਹਿਰਦੈ ਗਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
whom the three hundred thirty million gods search for — meeting the Guru, one sings of Him in the heart. ॥2॥
Twenty-four hours a day the wind chants Your Name.
The earth is the servant and slave at Your feet.
ਖਾਣੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਰਬ ਨਿਵਾਸੀ; ਸਭਨਾ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
You dwell in all the sources of creation and all speech; You are pleasing to every mind. ॥3॥
The True Master is known through the Guru.
Through the perfect Guru's Word He is recognised.
ਜਿਨ ਪੀਆ ਸੇਈ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਸੇ; ਸਚੇ ਸਚਿ ਅਘਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
Those who drink it are satisfied; through the Truest of the true they are fulfilled. ॥4॥
In his home (heart) there is poise; he is at peace,
enjoying bliss and delight, playing forever,
ਸੋ ਧਨਵੰਤਾ ਸੋ ਵਡ ਸਾਹਾ; ਜੋ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
he is wealthy, he is a great king, who focuses his mind on the Guru's feet. ॥5॥
ਤੁਧੁ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਦਾਤਾ. ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਸੁਆਮੀ; ਲਵੈ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
There is no Giver as great as You, O Master; none can equal You. ॥6॥
ਜਿਸੁ ਤੂੰ ਤੁਠਾ; ਸੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਧਿਆਏ ॥
One with whom You are pleased meditates on You.
He practises the teaching of the holy.
ਆਪਿ ਤਰੈ ਸਗਲੇ ਕੁਲ ਤਾਰੇ; ਤਿਸੁ. ਦਰਗਹ ਠਾਕ, ਨ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
He is saved himself and saves all his family; he meets no obstruction at Your court. ॥7॥
